summary: Independently inspected Factory's full green report and Playwright last-run for the frozen tree. Concurrent mixed reservations and rejection before model calls cover AC-1. Quota dialog validates all five rows, aggregate 41/150 and 0/150, error recovery and exhausted feedback at mobile, tablet and desktop for AC-2. Browser coverage includes manual subtask persistence and AI proposal selection and confirmation, and quota-enabled route tests verify decomposition and successful status updates for AC-3.

findings.title: Subtask writes and quota persistence are tested separately
findings.detail: Browser checks prove manual and AI-generated subtasks persist, and unit and route coverage proves quota-enabled launches. The end-to-end test does not compare a real enabled counter before and after both forms of subtask writes.
